description: Run TakeMeUp's free GDPR and personal-data check on one of the user's CVs, for the CV's country: flags details such as date of birth, photo, marital status or nationality that can invite discrimination or aren't expected there. No AI, no cost. Use before sending a CV to an employer in the EU.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: check_takemeup_cv_gdpr
title: GDPR check (free)
